verdict.rationale: Sentry's Seer Autofix finds root causes and generates suggested code fixes for errors (sentry-docs-40, sentry-docs-26, sentry-docs-13). Sentry also documents a coding-agent integration that sends Seer's analysis to an agent for automated fix generation and pull request creation (sentry-docs-41). Seer requires a paid subscription (sentry-docs-59). Missing for 10: clear evidence that Seer opens PRs natively rather than through a connected external coding agent, detail on the human-review workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
